texte.Ancrer la conduite responsable dans les: Embed responsible business conduct in policies and management systems
texte.Apprécier son implication dans l'inciden: Assess your involvement in the impact
texte.Assurer la réparation ou y coopérer: Provide remediation or co-operate in it
texte.Assurer la réparation ou y coopérer, lor: Provide remediation or co-operate in it, where appropriate
texte.Causer, contribuer, ou être lié : la que: Causing, contributing, or being linked: the three-answer question that decides the level of due diligence expected. It is filled in on the “process” screen, and it is what caps the rate.
texte.Ce guide est VOLONTAIRE : c'est la mise: This guidance is VOLUNTARY: it implements two OECD recommendations, it is not a harmonised standard. It opens no presumption of conformity, and no date will change that.
texte.Ce que ce taux mesure s'appelle « couver: What this rate measures is called “coverage of the examples retained”, never compliance: an organisation can hold them all and still fall short on a risk none of them names.
texte.Ce qui empêche la diligence d'être un ex: What stops due diligence being an annual exercise: the document calls for looking for what earlier passes missed.
texte.Ce qui est de l'OCDE, et ce qui est du c: What comes from the OECD, and what comes from the firm
texte.Ce sont les éléments d'une liste imbriqu: These are the items of a nested list that the document numbers as a top-level list: each one is a factor to consider, and the sentence that introduces them is in the previous example.
texte.Ce taux dit la part des exemples pratiqu: This rate states the share of the practical examples retained by your groups that you declare held. It is NOT a compliance rate: the document itself writes that its examples do not constitute an exhaustive check list, and no body issues an attestation against this guidance. An organisation can have held all # examples and still fall short on due diligence for a risk none of them names.
texte.Ces lignes sont celles du document : c'e: These rows are the document's own: it is the OECD that brings its six steps alongside the provisions of # other frameworks, in # rows. The document writes that this is NOT an equivalency framework — the scope and nature of the expectations vary from one framework to another. And of those # frameworks, Sentinel measures #: the other # are named here and not held by the firm.
texte.Cet instrument est VOLONTAIRE : c'est le: This instrument is VOLUNTARY: it is the implementation guidance for two OECD recommendations, not a harmonised standard. It opens no presumption of conformity, no body issues an attestation against it, and no date will change that — unlike prEN #, which will carry presumption the day it is cited in the Official Journal. The work done here serves the enterprise's due diligence and the frameworks the roadmaps name; it stands in for none of them.
texte.Chercher ce que les passes précédentes o: Looking for what earlier passes missed, checking that assessed risks have not become unacceptable, and measuring the effectiveness of stakeholder engagement itself.
texte.Communiquer à l'extérieur les politiques: Communicating externally the policies, the processes, the impacts identified and prioritised, the prioritisation criteria, the measures taken and their results — with due regard for commercial confidentiality and competition law.
texte.Conseil de l'Europe — Convention-cadre s: Council of Europe — Framework Convention on AI and the HUDERIA methodology
texte.Creative Commons Attribution # Internati: Creative Commons Attribution # International (CC BY #) — © OECD #. Reproduction, translation and adaptation are permitted, subject to citing the work, identifying changes and carrying the notices the licence imposes. Third-party material is excluded from it.
texte.Croire que la licence autorise tout : le: Believing the licence allows everything: third-party material is excluded from it, and the OECD's logo and visual identity are forbidden.
texte.Des attentes communiquées une fois à la: Expectations communicated once at signature and never taken up again. The document calls for channels that last.
texte.Des politiques écrites, adoptées et diff: Policies written, adopted and disseminated, stating the organisation's commitment to the OECD AI Principles and the MNE Guidelines — and carrying the plan for implementing due diligence, for its own operations as for its business relationships.
texte.Des recommandations biaisées dans un ser: Biased recommendations in a public welfare service, resulting in the cancellation of aid for thousands of families.
texte.Des évaluations itératives et de plus en: Iterative and increasingly in-depth assessments, over TWO perimeters the document separates: the organisation's own activities, and its business relationships.
texte.Deux exemples pratiques seulement, et l': Two practical examples only, and the strongest expectation in the framework: as soon as the enterprise causes or contributes, it is expected to remediate the harm, not merely to prevent it.
texte.En faire une équivalence. Le document éc: Turning it into an equivalence. The document writes that this is not an equivalency framework — and of those twenty frameworks, Sentinel measures three.
texte.Entre dans le plan de l'étape #, après l: Enters the step # plan, after the salient risks.
texte.Faire cesser ce qui cause ou contribue,: Ceasing what causes or contributes, and building the plans that prevent and mitigate future impacts.
